newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank says no emergency meeting planned.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank says no emergency meeting planned.

text.p: The Bundesbank on Tuesday denied market rumours that its central bank policy council was planning an emergency meeting on Wednesday.

"That is absolute nonsense," a spokesman said, repeating a comment he had made earlier in the day in response to earlier market suggestions such a meeting had been planned for Tuesday. The comment was made in response to Reuter enquiries.
